Figure 1.1 · Spot the candle and compare volumeSix synthetic candles with their volume bars. The final candle is outlined as the candidate. A dashed line in the volume panel marks the average of the five previous volume bars. The task is to identify candle direction and whether candidate volume is above or below that baseline, without interpreting market direction. Figure 1.1 First, spot the facts No interpretation yet. Identify the highlighted candle and compare its volume with the dashed baseline.
